attempts.summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL10, mariadb-server-galera 10.11.18) with an appdb.orders table holding application data. Performed a full cluster shutdown (all 3 nodes stopped) to simulate a maintenance window, then correctly restored it by bootstrapping the node with the highest grastate seqno (node1) via galera_new_cluster and rejoining node2/node3 via SST. All pre-maintenance committed writes survived and all three members served again post-recovery. Then, per the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol, restarted each node one at a time (native `reboot`), proved changed boot_id on each, and confirmed each node auto-rejoined the cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with all data intact after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (never restarting more than one node at a time).
